name: @yyc3/music-server
description: YYC³ D-Music 服务端（22 文件 / 21 路由模块）— Node 20+ 运行时，Hono + Prisma/pg + PostgreSQL 15

scripts.test:deno: env -u NODE_OPTIONS -u VSCODE_INSPECTOR_OPTIONS deno test --allow-all test-deno
scripts.test:deno:coverage: rm -rf /tmp/deno-cov && env -u NODE_OPTIONS -u VSCODE_INSPECTOR_OPTIONS deno test --allow-all --coverage=/tmp/deno-cov test-deno && env -u NODE_OPTIONS -u VSCODE_INSPECTOR_OPTIONS deno coverage /tmp/deno-cov --exclude=test-deno --exclude=src/index.ts --lcov --output=/tmp/deno-src.lcov
